title: Chain Glaive
description: An epic RPG-styled 3D weapon asset pack for Minecraft using custom anvil renames (CIT).
body:
# ⚔️ Custom 3D Weapon Models (Anvil Rename / CIT)

This is a clean, high-quality 3D asset pack designed for Minecraft Java Edition. It replaces or adds custom 3D models for weapons using the Anvil Rename feature, bringing an RPG atmosphere to your gameplay without needing complex server setups.

### 🛠️ How to Use (Anvil Rename)
To see these custom 3D models in your game, you just need to rename the specific base weapon in an Anvil. 

**Requirements:**
* **OptiFine** OR the **CIT Resewn** mod installed on your client.
* (Without these, the models will not load and will look like default Minecraft items).

---

### 📦 Available Rename List:
*(Please rename your item to match the names below exactly)*
* Chain Glaive (Diamond, Netjerite sword)

---

## 📄 License & Terms of Use
* **Personal Use:** You are free to download and use this asset pack for your personal gameplay, singleplayer worlds, or your own multiplayer servers.
* **Prohibitions:** You are strictly prohibited from re-uploading, redistributing, or reselling these 3D models/textures to any other platforms or websites.
